title: Kicked Spicy Filipino Chicken Skewers
description: Spicy Filipino chicken skewers with a cheese-pull, featuring red onions and shio-cure, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish combines Mediterranean-friendly flavors with a kick of spice.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the chicken, red onion, and chili peppers onto wooden skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and shio-cure.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the shredded mozzarella cheese with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Once the skewers are cooked, place them on a wooden board and top with the cheese mixture.
Return the skewers to the grill and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skewers from the grill and drizzle with lemon juice.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
